name: Divine Right raises crit and spell hit chance; its parry bonus never reaches a Sun Cleric's parry stat (#2204)
contract: Divine Right rank 1 (680631) and rank 2 (681469) are SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE stat auras with three native, family-agnostic effects (spelldump.py confirms DieSides 1 on all three, so CalcValue = EffectBasePoints + 1 deterministically): effect 0 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT (290), EffectBasePoints 1/3 -> +2/+4; effect 1 SPELL_AURA_MOD_PARRY_PERCENT (47), EffectBasePoints 1/3 -> +2/+4; effect 2 SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_HIT_CHANCE (55), EffectBasePoints 4/9 -> +5/+10. This scenario asserts each effect's own resolved value via aura_amount (AuraEffect::GetAmount(), fixed at apply time) instead of a before/after delta on melee_crit_chance/parry_chance/spell_hit_chance: on a freshly spawned harness fixture those PLAYER_CRIT_PERCENTAGE/PLAYER_PARRY_PERCENTAGE/m_modSpellHitChance fields read 0 before any stat-recalculating trigger has ever run (no login-time UpdateAllCritPercentages/UpdateParryPercentage/UpdateSpellHitChances call), so a post-learn delta bundles the class's own never-before-computed base contribution together with the aura -- the run that originally failed here read melee_crit_chance jump from 0 to 6.15 on rank 1, not the promised 2, because of exactly this cold-start baseline, not a wrong aura value. This is the same measurement fault already fixed for Fel Infusion (#3738) in this batch (see sun-cleric-felsworn-fel-infusion equivalent contract note there): a before/after read of a Player::Update*Percentage() field cannot isolate one aura's own contribution. AuraEffect::HandleAuraModCritPct (SpellAuraEffects.cpp) calls UpdateAllWeaponDependentCritAuras/UpdateAllSpellCritChances unconditionally for any class, and AuraEffect::HandleModSpellHitChance calls Player::UpdateSpellHitChances, which reads GetTotalAuraModifier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_HIT_CHANCE, ...) with no class gating either -- both effects are confirmed native and working via aura_amount alone. Effect 1 (parry) is different: AuraEffect::HandleAuraModParryPercent does call Player::UpdateParryPercentage (StatSystem.cpp:876-921), but that function hardcodes a per-class parry_cap table with parry_cap[CLASS_PRIEST] = 0.0f, and the entire nondiminishing/diminishing calculation -- the only place SPELL_AURA_MOD_PARRY_PERCENT is read -- is guarded by `if (CanParry() && parry_cap[pclass] > 0.0f)`; when that is false (Priest legacy class) the function falls straight through to `SetStatFloatValue(PLAYER_PARRY_PERCENTAGE, 0.0f)`, discarding the aura's amount entirely. Sun Cleric's legacy class is CLASS_PRIEST (SharedDefines.h GetLegacyClassForCustomClass), and unlike CLASS_STARCALLER two lines above in the same function (an explicit comment and override: 'Starcaller learns Parry, unlike its general Druid stat fallback. Use the Hunter parry curve...'), Sun Cleric has no equivalent carve-out. So PLAYER_PARRY_PERCENTAGE is provably 0 for a Sun Cleric both before and after learning either rank of Divine Right, regardless of the aura's own +2/+4 value -- confirmed by source reading of StatSystem.cpp, not by tooltip assumption.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Rank 1's own crit-chance effect resolves to 2 (EffectBasePoints 1 + 1, DieSides 1)
Rank 1's own parry-chance effect resolves to 2 (EffectBasePoints 1 + 1, DieSides 1) -- the data is right even though it never reaches the parry stat, see below
Rank 1's own spell-hit effect resolves to 5 (EffectBasePoints 4 + 1, DieSides 1)
Rank 2's own crit-chance effect resolves to 4 (EffectBasePoints 3 + 1, DieSides 1)
Rank 2's own parry-chance effect resolves to 4 (EffectBasePoints 3 + 1, DieSides 1) -- the data is right even though it never reaches the parry stat, see below
Rank 2's own spell-hit effect resolves to 10 (EffectBasePoints 9 + 1, DieSides 1)
Rank 1's real parry_chance stat stays 0: parry_cap[CLASS_PRIEST]=0 in Player::UpdateParryPercentage discards the aura
Rank 2's stronger parry aura still never moves the real parry_chance stat, same class-cap gate
